source.title: Craft Resume – Retail session CSV capture and disenchant results
source.author: R4s0n3

notes: New primary-capture lead only, NOT a measured gameplay cohort. Retail 12.1.5 Craft Resume 0.5.0 claims to track actual crafting/disenchant outputs and Resourcefulness returned reagents, saved sessions and CSV exports; source page publishes no player CSV, per-item completed operations, matched material IDs, zero-event histograms or skill/bonus records. This is distinct from prior ProspectMate aggregate-source check. Search results on named Midnight gear, ore and herbs returned already-indexed JD3K, Cardinalai, Stormwarning, Honeybone, SeniorEmployment932 and Looter snapshots or no original per-cast data. Do not convert collector capability into quantitative evidence. Candidate follow-up: locate *original* independently exported Retail CSV, then check operation ID, per-cast source itemLink (272246 at ilvl305), output IDs, quality, build, skill/spec, zero outcomes and input refunds before estimator consideration.
lookingFor: Unpublished independent Retail 12.1.5 per-operation session CSVs (not source-only tables) for Miststalker's Wristbands item 272246, Umbral Tin Ore 237362/237363, Refulgent Copper 237359/237361, Brilliant Silver 237364/237365 and Tranquility Bloom 236761/236767.
